title: CaptureRecord
description: Who captured what, where, when and how, for one site visit at one property. A visit holds one or more captures; each capture is one floor or area scanned in one mode, registered separately with its own captureId. Written by the app as Source Register/{visitId}/capture-record.json. Optional fields are omitted, never null.

schemaVersion.description: 1.1.0 adds the optional compass reading of each capture (heading, headingAccuracy, headingSource, headingRecordedAt) and headingIssue; 1.2.0 adds captureSource and sketch. An older document does not carry the later fields. Readers accept every version; writers write 1.2.0.

hub.description: The HUB project this visit belongs to.

dealId.description: HUB deal id, as returned by the HUB.

address.description: Property address from the HUB and whether the operator confirmed it on site.

formatted.description: Single-line address exactly as shown by the HUB.

confirmedOnSite.description: True only when the operator confirmed on site that this is the address being captured.

operator.description: The signed-in person who made the captures.

userId.description: Directory id of the signed-in user, when known.

model.description: Hardware model identifier, for example iPhone17,1.

marketingName.description: Human-readable model name, for example iPhone 16 Pro.

visitedAt.description: Start of the site visit (the visit date).

captures.description: Every capture made during the visit, one per floor or area scan. captureId and areaKey are each unique within the record.

then.description: A 1.0.0 document carries none of the fields added in 1.1.0 or 1.2.0.
A 1.1.0 document carries none of the fields added in 1.2.0.

dateTime.description: UTC timestamp, whole seconds, RFC 3339 with Z.

areaKey.description: Stable path-safe key of a floor or area, for example floor-1. Used in package folder paths.

captureMode.description: Shown to users as One room, Whole floor, Exterior.

capture.description: One floor or area scan, registered separately.

label.description: Floor or area label shown to people, for example Floor 1.

units.description: Geometry is always metres. Display is the unit system shown to the operator.

capturedAt.description: Start of this capture (the capture date).

coverageNotes.description: Free-text notes on coverage, obscured surfaces and gaps. Empty string when there is nothing to note.

omittedRooms.description: Rooms the operator chose not to scan. Empty when none.

inaccessibleRooms.description: Rooms or spaces that could not be entered. Empty when none.

heading.description: Compass bearing of this capture's -Z axis (plan up: plan y is -Z), in degrees clockwise from north, 0 <= heading < 360, one decimal. True north when headingSource is true, magnetic north when magnetic. Read by the phone compass at the start of the scan and matched to the scan frame; never typed. Omitted when there is no reading: the orientation is then not verified.

headingAccuracy.description: Compass accuracy reported by the phone for the reading, whole degrees rounded up: the heading is within plus or minus this value. Verified at 10 or less with a true heading; approximate up to 30; not verified above 30.

headingSource.description: true: corrected to true north with the phone's location. magnetic: magnetic north only (Location off).

headingRecordedAt.description: When the compass reading was taken.

headingIssue.description: Why there is no heading although the app tried: rejected (readings disagreed or could not be matched to the scan), not_calibrated (the compass reported no valid accuracy), unavailable (no usable compass on the device). Never present together with heading.

captureSource.description: How the capture was made (1.2.0): lidar, a RoomPlan scan; sketch, a hand sketch or existing plan with measurements entered by the operator (spec F14). Absent in older documents, which means lidar. A sketch capture carries no compass field: there is no scan frame to read a heading into.

sketch.description: What the sketch solver had (1.2.0). Present exactly when captureSource is sketch.

measurements.description: complete: every wall and opening was measured and the ceiling height too; limited: at least one wall, opening or the ceiling height is estimated or assumed, or a closure residual is over the tolerance.

wallsMeasured.description: Walls whose length the operator measured.

wallsEstimated.description: Walls whose length was estimated (an "about" value, the sketch proportion, or a square corner that was not measured).

ceilingHeightSource.description: measured: entered by the operator; assumed: the default 2.44 m.

closureResidualMm.description: The largest closure residual of the capture's rooms in millimetres (the lengths going one way along an axis against the lengths coming back), after the residual was distributed. Omitted when no room had every wall measured.
